products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-LR1121-HF
products.summary: 4 MiB Flash / 2 MiB PSRAM LR1121主控，HF/LF及USB转接套件独立；精确SPI输出观测，无虚构无线响应。
limitations: Actual guest SPI/GPIO routing is observed only. LR1121 command responses, busy/IRQ, modulation, RF peer/range/power and Meshtastic transport are unmodeled. No chip/status reply is fabricated.
Bare HF/LF modules have exposedGPIO0 but no physical BOOT key or USB receptacle. Only Kit includes the USB adapter with BOOT/RESET and FFC.
The documentation parameter table19x22mm and the controller drawing21x41mm differ in scope; full controller model follows the explicit21x41mm drawing and native board CAD.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

Manufacturer STEP omits the visible RF metal cover. It is added as an explicitly photo-derived hollow shell; native topology stays unscaled and complete. Cover wall thickness/fit/printed RF markings remain unknown.
HF/LF share this manufacturer XF board CAD; frequency and exact SKU remain separate knowledge. Shield text is not invented or borrowed across variants.
Bare module has no USB connector or physical BOOT/RESET button; adapter is not silently included.
Official firmware trial is not proof of successful startup or full compatibility; no physical hardware test.

chronology.notes: 官方发布日期未确认；目录位置用于优先队列，不作为发布日期。
